title: Is something from Mallworld visiting me? Has anything like this happened to anyone else?
content: So twice already, I've waken up from dreaming about being in mallworld and seeing what looks like a young woman standing at the door to my room. It's dark, but I can still see her. She is dressed like a little girl, but she's obviously in her early 20s. Only thing is, she has no face. It's all blacked out. Her hair is tied back into two ponytails and she wearing a dress of which I can't really tell the color of. but it reminds me a little of Dorothy's dress from the Wizard of Oz. She just stands there and eventually backs away and vanishes into the dark corner where the door is at. I know I have seen a girl like this in the mall and sometimes withing the school. I'm never near her. I've never talked to her. But I've seen her here and there. Now, twice, I've woken up and there she is. Faceless. It's creeping me out. Both times I've gotten up and just gotten up to have snack. Anyone else experience something like this?
